headline: Who Gives A Crap Reports Customer Data Breach Via Third Party App
seoTitle: Who Gives A Crap Data Breach Incident
metaDescription: Who Gives A Crap has confirmed a security breach involving a third-party software provider, resulting in the unauthorized exposure of customer data.
aiSummaryBullets: Who Gives A Crap reported that a third-party software provider experienced a security breach.
Exposed customer information includes names, contact details, and total purchase history.
The company confirmed that no passwords or payment card details were compromised in the incident.
aiContextParagraph: The Australian consumer goods company Who Gives A Crap recently confirmed that it was the subject of a data security incident involving an external software vendor. According to official company reports, unauthorized individuals gained access to specific customer records stored within the third-party system. The compromised data set primarily consists of customer names and contact information, as well as details regarding total expenditure. However, the company emphasized that sensitive security credentials, such as account passwords and banking or credit card information, remain secure and were not involved in the breach. This incident highlights the growing risks associated with third-party software supply chains in digital business environments. The company has begun communicating with affected parties as investigations into the scope of the unauthorized access continue following the initial discovery of the vulnerability by the software provider.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to a notable spike in public search interest, reaching a signal of 64/100, as customers look for details on the breach.

sources.articleTitle: Who Gives A Crap confirms customer data exposed in third party software breach
